ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.25 high-intensity to 0.75 low-intensity distribution; white pixels are concentrated in the distal-lateral regions while black pixels dominate the central 60% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, high-contrast white mottled patches on distal lobes; Left lobe: contiguous white region covering the upper outer quadrant; Right lobe: fragmented, heavily speckled white region in the corresponding upper outer quadrant; Central fluke and peduncle are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 12% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme high-frequency irregularity along the entire trailing boundary; multiple deep, non-uniform notches and jagged peaks extracted from the linear boundary, notably prominent on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the peduncle base transitioning to an upward curve at the distal tips; trailing edge exhibits a complex, multi-serrated profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of small (3-8 pixel diameter) circular high-contrast clusters concentrated along the trailing edge and within the distal white mottled regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, dark linear pixel disruptions visible against the white pigmentation on the right lobe, appearing as unaligned horizontal rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jagged tissue loss and irregular notching along the entire trailing edge margin; distinct deep indentation at the terminal tip of the left lobe.
